resources.string: Open Pebrel on your computer, go to Settings → Phone Remote, and turn it on.
Point at the QR code on your computer
The QR code is single-use and expires in 10 minutes.
Enable the camera to scan your computer’s QR code here.
No camera is available. Use a pairing code or paste an invitation.
The camera did not start. Try again, use a code, or paste an invitation.
QR code read. Check the pairing result or scan again.
Paste the content from Copy complete invitation on your computer
On different networks? Use a self-hosted relay
Both devices need to be on the same Wi-Fi or local network.
The 8 digits below the QR code on your computer
Scan the code shown by your Pebrel computer
On your computer, open Settings → Phone Remote. Scan the QR code, compare the verification codes, then approve this phone on your computer.
Check that this code matches the one in Phone Remote on your computer. Approve only when both codes match.
Invalid invitation or connection settings. Check the address and keys.
Connect to the same Wi-Fi as your computer. Select the computer below and enter the code shown under its QR code in Settings → Phone Remote.
Looking for computers on this network…
No computer found. Check that Phone Remote is on and both devices are on the same Wi-Fi. You can also scan the QR code or paste the complete invitation.
The code is incorrect, expired or already used. Refresh it on your computer and try again.
The computer did not complete the connection. Check its network and firewall, then refresh the pairing code before retrying.
